ex.en: A white rabbit hopped across the grass towards us.
ex.zh: 一只白兔蹦蹦跳跳地穿过草地，朝我们跑来。

ex.en: Introducing rabbits into new environments can damage native vegetation and disrupt the balance of local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 将兔子引入新环境可能破坏原生植被，扰乱当地生态系统的平衡。

tip: rabbit泛指兔；hare通常指腿耳更长的野兔。

ex.en: Our cat sleeps in a sunny spot by the window.
ex.zh: 我们家的猫睡在窗边阳光照得到的地方。

ex.en: Keeping pet cats indoors can help protect native birds, particularly in areas with vulnerable wildlife populations.
ex.zh: 将宠物猫养在室内有助于保护本地鸟类，尤其是在野生动物种群脆弱的地区。

tip: big cats指狮、虎等大型猫科动物。

ex.en: A tiny mouse slipped behind the cupboard before breakfast.
ex.zh: 早饭前，一只小老鼠溜到了橱柜后面。

ex.en: Using a mouse for long periods may cause wrist discomfort, so office workers should take regular breaks.
ex.zh: 长时间使用鼠标可能引起手腕不适，因此办公室职员应定时休息。

tip: 老鼠的复数是mice；鼠标的复数可用mice或mouses。

ex.en: Our dog waits by the door every afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们的狗每天下午都守在门边。

ex.en: Training a guide dog requires considerable time, but it can greatly improve someone's independence.
ex.zh: 训练一只导盲犬需要大量时间，但它能显著增强使用者的独立生活能力。

col: be dogged by problems｜长期受问题困扰
tip: 动词常见被动式be dogged by，表示长期受困扰。

ex.en: A green frog jumped from the stone into our pond.
ex.zh: 一只绿色的青蛙从石头上跳进了我们的池塘。

ex.en: Declining frog populations can indicate environmental damage because these animals are sensitive to changes in water quality.
ex.zh: 青蛙数量下降可能表明环境遭到破坏，因为它们对水质变化十分敏感。

tip: 可数名词，复数为frogs；toad指蟾蜍。

ex.en: I found your scarf and put it by the door.
ex.zh: 我找到了你的围巾，把它放在门边了。

ex.en: It is essential for cities to provide reliable public transport if they want to reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 城市若想缓解交通拥堵，就必须提供可靠的公共交通。

tip: 小写it是代词；大写IT才表示信息技术。

ex.en: We had a nice picnic beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边愉快地野餐了一次。

ex.en: Although nice surroundings matter, affordable housing and reliable transport are more important to many urban residents.
ex.zh: 虽然宜人的环境很重要，但对许多城市居民而言，可负担的住房和可靠的交通更为重要。

col: be nice to someone｜友善地对待某人
tip: nice含义较宽，正式写作宜换成更具体的形容词。

ex.en: That cute kitten is sleeping inside my slipper.
ex.zh: 那只可爱的小猫正睡在我的拖鞋里。

ex.en: Advertisements often feature cute animals to attract attention and create positive feelings towards a product.
ex.zh: 广告常用可爱的动物吸引注意，让人们对产品产生好感。

tip: 偏口语，常形容婴儿、小动物或讨喜的外表。

ex.en: Could you pass me that bowl beside the window?
ex.zh: 你能把窗边的那个碗递给我吗？

ex.en: Research suggests that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.
ex.zh: 研究表明，能够接触绿地有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。

tip: 作指示词时复数为those；引导宾语从句常可省略。

ex.en: The children waved as they boarded the bus.
ex.zh: 孩子们一边上公交车一边挥手。

ex.en: When a student receives constructive feedback, they are more likely to identify weaknesses and improve their performance.
ex.zh: 学生收到建设性反馈后，更有可能发现不足并改善表现。

tip: 单数they也搭配are、have，不用is、has。

ex.en: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
ex.zh: 我回家时，那只狗摇起了尾巴。

ex.en: Some animals use their tails for balance, which helps them move safely through complex forest habitats.
ex.zh: 一些动物用尾巴保持平衡，这有助于它们在复杂的森林栖息地中安全移动。

tip: tail指尾巴；tale指故事，两词同音。

ex.en: My sister loves watching animals at the local farm.
ex.zh: 我妹妹喜欢在当地农场看动物。

ex.en: Protecting animal habitats is essential because biodiversity supports stable ecosystems and benefits human wellbeing.
ex.zh: 保护动物栖息地至关重要，因为生物多样性有助于维持生态系统稳定，并造福人类。

tip: animal 不仅指哺乳动物；鸟、鱼和昆虫也属于动物。

ex.en: The soup tasted so bad that I stopped eating.
ex.zh: 这汤太难喝了，我便不再喝了。

ex.en: Bad air quality can discourage outdoor exercise and increase health risks among children and older adults.
ex.zh: 空气质量差会使人减少户外锻炼，并增加儿童和老年人的健康风险。

col: bad for your health｜有害健康
tip: 比较级worse，最高级worst；badly是副词。

ex.en: A tiny green bug landed on my sleeve.
ex.zh: 一只绿色小虫落在了我的袖子上。

ex.en: A software bug can disrupt essential services, highlighting the importance of thorough testing before release.
ex.zh: 软件错误可能导致基本服务中断，这凸显了发布前进行全面测试的重要性。

col: fix a bug｜修复程序错误
tip: 口语中bug可泛指小虫；技术语境常指程序错误。

ex.en: We ate breakfast on the sunny balcony this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，我们在阳光充足的阳台上吃了早餐。

ex.en: Regions with sunny climates can generate substantial amounts of electricity through well-planned solar energy projects.
ex.zh: 阳光充足的地区可以通过规划合理的太阳能项目产生大量电力。

tip: sunny强调阳光足，不一定表示气温高。

ex.en: The sun appeared just as we reached the beach.
ex.zh: 我们刚到海滩，太阳就出来了。

ex.en: Energy from the sun can provide a renewable alternative to fossil fuels in regions with suitable conditions.
ex.zh: 在条件适宜的地区，太阳能可以成为化石燃料的可再生替代能源。

tip: 指太阳通常用the sun；in the sun表示在阳光下。

ex.en: It was too windy to eat lunch outside today.
ex.zh: 今天风太大，没法在外面吃午饭。

ex.en: Windy coastal regions can generate renewable electricity, although turbines must be positioned carefully to protect wildlife.
ex.zh: 多风的沿海地区可以生产可再生电力，但风力涡轮机必须谨慎选址，以保护野生动物。

col: a windy day｜刮大风的一天
tip: 天气义读/ˈwɪndi/；描述道路蜿蜒通常用winding。

ex.en: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat away.
ex.zh: 突然一阵风把我的帽子吹走了。

ex.en: Investing in wind power can help countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels and lower carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 投资风能可以帮助各国减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低碳排放。

tip: 风读/wɪnd/；缠绕读/waɪnd/，过去式wound。

ex.en: We stayed indoors and baked bread on that rainy afternoon.
ex.zh: 那个下雨的下午，我们待在室内烤面包。

ex.en: In regions with a long rainy season, reliable drainage systems are essential for protecting homes and roads.
ex.zh: 在雨季漫长的地区，可靠的排水系统对保护房屋和道路至关重要。

tip: rainy是形容词；正在下雨用It is raining。

ex.en: It was cloudy, so we left our sunglasses at home.
ex.zh: 当时天阴着，所以我们把太阳镜留在了家里。

ex.en: Solar panels can still generate electricity on cloudy days, although their output is usually lower.
ex.zh: 太阳能电池板在阴天仍能发电，不过发电量通常较低。

tip: 既可形容天空多云，也可形容液体浑浊。

ex.en: A dark cloud drifted slowly across the afternoon sky.
ex.zh: 一朵乌云缓缓飘过午后的天空。

ex.en: Strong emotions can cloud public judgment when communities debate the benefits and risks of new technologies.
ex.zh: 当社区讨论新技术的利弊时，强烈的情绪可能影响公众的判断。

col: a cloud of dust｜一团尘土
cloud someone's judgment｜影响某人的判断
tip: cloud作动词可指使判断不清，如cloud your judgment。

ex.en: The weather turned sunny just before our picnic.
ex.zh: 就在我们野餐前，天气转晴了。

ex.en: Extreme weather can disrupt food production and increase the cost of basic goods for vulnerable communities.
ex.zh: 极端天气会扰乱粮食生产，并推高弱势社区基本商品的价格。

col: weather a storm｜经受风暴；渡过危机
tip: 表示天气时不可数；climate指长期气候特征。

ex.en: Let's eat outside today while the weather is warm.
ex.zh: 今天天气暖和，我们到外面吃饭吧。

ex.en: Today, many universities offer flexible courses that allow students to combine employment with further education.
ex.zh: 如今，许多大学开设灵活的课程，让学生能够兼顾工作和继续教育。

tip: today既可指今天，也可泛指当今；前面不用on。

ex.en: I grabbed my hat before stepping into the sunshine.
ex.zh: 走到阳光下之前，我拿起了帽子。

ex.en: Wearing a wide-brimmed hat can reduce sun exposure, particularly for people who spend long hours working outdoors.
ex.zh: 戴宽檐帽可以减少日晒，对长时间在户外工作的人尤其有用。

tip: 戴着帽子用wear；戴上帽子的动作用put on。

ex.en: This little plant needs more sunlight and less water.
ex.zh: 这株小植物需要更多阳光和更少的水。

ex.en: Local authorities should plant more trees to improve air quality and provide shade in crowded neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 地方政府应多种树，以改善空气质量，并为人口密集的社区提供绿荫。

tip: plant可指植物或工厂；作动词时常表示种植。

ex.en: Be careful; the soup is still very hot.
ex.zh: 小心，汤还很烫。

ex.en: As summers become increasingly hot, cities need more shaded public spaces to protect residents from heat.
ex.zh: 随着夏季越来越炎热，城市需要更多有遮阴设施的公共空间来保护居民免受高温影响。

tip: 形容食物时可指“烫”或“辣”，需结合语境。

ex.en: The soup is very hot, so let it cool.
ex.zh: 汤很烫，先让它凉一凉。

ex.en: Reliable public transport is very important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
ex.zh: 对于买不起汽车的居民来说，可靠的公共交通非常重要。

tip: very通常修饰形容词或副词；修饰动词常用very much。

ex.en: We celebrated the apple harvest with a homemade pie.
ex.zh: 我们做了一个自制苹果派，庆祝苹果丰收。

ex.en: Unpredictable rainfall can reduce the annual harvest, threatening rural incomes and increasing food prices in cities.
ex.zh: 难以预测的降雨可能减少年度收成，威胁农村收入并推高城市食品价格。

tip: 作名词可指收割活动，也可指收获的作物或产量。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 harvest。

ex.en: We shared a slice of lemon cake after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，我们分着吃了一片柠檬蛋糕。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by offering fresh fruit instead of cake at school celebrations.
ex.zh: 学校可以在校内庆祝活动中提供新鲜水果而非蛋糕，以鼓励更健康的饮食。

col: a slice of cake｜一片蛋糕
be caked in mud｜沾满厚厚的泥
tip: 整个蛋糕可数；泛指蛋糕这种食物时常不可数。

ex.en: He lit a candle when the electricity went off.
ex.zh: 停电时，他点了一支蜡烛。

ex.en: Although candles create a pleasant atmosphere, they should never be left burning unattended in homes or public spaces.
ex.zh: 虽然蜡烛能营造宜人的氛围，但在住宅或公共场所，绝不能让其在无人看管时燃烧。

col: blow out a candle｜吹灭蜡烛
tip: 点蜡烛用light；吹灭用blow out。

ex.en: My sister wrapped the gift in bright yellow paper.
ex.zh: 姐姐用鲜黄色的纸把礼物包了起来。

ex.en: Schools should nurture each child's gift rather than judge everyone by the same narrow standards.
ex.zh: 学校应培养每个孩子的天赋，而不是用同一套狭隘的标准评判所有人。

col: a gift for languages｜语言天赋
tip: 表示天赋时常用 a gift for，后接名词或动名词。

ex.en: Our plane landed just before the rain began.
ex.zh: 我们的飞机刚降落，雨就下起来了。

ex.en: Travelling by plane saves time, but its environmental impact should be considered when planning transport policy.
ex.zh: 乘飞机出行节省时间，但制定交通政策时应考虑其环境影响。

tip: by plane不加冠词；on a plane需加冠词。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 plane。

ex.en: My little cousin tucked her doll into a tiny bed.
ex.zh: 我的小表妹把她的洋娃娃安顿在一张小床上。

ex.en: Playing with dolls can help young children develop communication skills and explore different social roles.
ex.zh: 玩玩偶可以帮助幼儿培养沟通能力，并探索不同的社会角色。

tip: 通常指人形玩具；用来称呼女性可能显得轻慢。

ex.en: I tapped my card to pay for the groceries.
ex.zh: 我刷卡支付了买食品杂货的钱。

ex.en: Providing every student with a library card encourages independent reading and improves access to educational resources.
ex.zh: 为每位学生办理借书证，有助于鼓励自主阅读，并改善教育资源的获取条件。

tip: play cards指打牌，cards用复数，前面不加冠词。

ex.en: Come inside and warm your hands by the fire.
ex.zh: 进来在火边暖暖手吧。

ex.en: Much of the funding for public libraries comes from local government rather than private donations.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆的大部分资金来自地方政府，而非私人捐赠。

tip: 不规则变化：come–came–come；come from表示来自。

ex.en: I love walking by the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我很喜欢晚饭后沿着河边散步。

ex.en: Schools can develop children's love of reading by providing diverse books and regular library visits.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供多样化的图书和安排定期参观图书馆，培养孩子对阅读的热爱。

col: love of learning｜对学习的热爱
tip: love doing和love to do均可表示喜欢做某事。

ex.en: Let's meet outside the library after lunch today.
ex.zh: 我们今天午饭后在图书馆外见吧。

ex.en: Public transport services must meet the needs of residents who cannot afford private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通服务必须满足那些买不起私家车的居民的需求。

col: meet someone for the first time｜初次见到某人
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为met；meet要求时意为满足。

ex.en: The kitten fell asleep inside an empty cardboard box.
ex.zh: 小猫在一个空纸箱里睡着了。

ex.en: Retailers can reduce packaging waste by choosing a box that closely matches the size of each product.
ex.zh: 零售商可以选择与每件商品大小相近的箱子，以减少包装浪费。

col: a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力
tip: 复数为boxes；a box of后接盒中物品。

ex.en: I left my book on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我把书落在厨房的桌子上了。

ex.en: Public libraries provide free access to books, helping people continue learning regardless of their income.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆提供免费借阅书籍的机会，让不同收入的人都能持续学习。

tip: book 作动词表示预订，可直接接房间、机票等。

ex.en: The dog chased the ball across the grass.
ex.zh: 那只狗追着球跑过草地。

ex.en: Simple ball games can help children develop coordination while encouraging cooperation and regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 简单的球类游戏能帮助儿童发展协调能力，同时促进合作和日常体育锻炼。

col: a ball of wool｜一团毛线
tip: 球类运动前通常不用冠词，如play football。

ex.en: My sister and I share a desk by the window.
ex.zh: 我和姐姐共用窗边的一张书桌。

ex.en: When residents share responsibility for public spaces, neighbourhoods often become cleaner and more welcoming.
ex.zh: 当居民共同承担公共空间的维护责任时，社区往往会变得更整洁、更宜居。

col: share something with someone｜与某人分享某物
tip: 与某人分享用share something with someone。

ex.en: My sister baked a lemon cake for my birthday.
ex.zh: 姐姐为我的生日烤了一个柠檬蛋糕。

ex.en: Although birthday celebrations vary across cultures, they often provide opportunities for families to spend time together.
ex.zh: 虽然不同文化中的生日庆祝方式各异，但它们往往能让家人有机会相聚。

tip: 在某人生日当天用on，不用in或at。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 birthday。

ex.en: We spent the afternoon baking bread in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都在厨房里烤面包。

ex.en: Schools could offer afternoon sports sessions to help students develop healthier habits and stronger friendships.
ex.zh: 学校可以在下午安排体育活动，帮助学生养成更健康的习惯并增进友谊。

tip: 泛指下午用in；具体某天下午用on。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 afternoon。

ex.en: I read a few pages before bed every night.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上睡前都会读几页书。

ex.en: Children who read regularly often develop stronger language skills and a broader understanding of the world.
ex.zh: 经常阅读的儿童通常能培养更强的语言能力，对世界也有更广泛的了解。

tip: 原形读/riːd/；过去式及过去分词读/red/。

ex.en: We sing our favourite songs while washing the dishes.
ex.zh: 我们一边洗碗，一边唱自己最喜欢的歌。

ex.en: Children who sing together regularly may develop greater confidence and stronger relationships with their classmates.
ex.zh: 经常一起唱歌的孩子可能会变得更加自信，与同学的关系也更加紧密。

col: sing in a choir｜在合唱团唱歌
tip: 不规则变化：sing—sang—sung。

ex.en: There is blue paint all over your hands.
ex.zh: 你的双手沾满了蓝色颜料。

ex.en: Schools should allow children to paint regularly, as creative activities can support emotional development and self-expression.
ex.zh: 学校应让孩子经常绘画，因为创意活动有助于情感发展和自我表达。

col: a coat of paint｜一层油漆
tip: paint多指用颜料画；draw多指用铅笔等画线条。

ex.en: We danced in the kitchen while dinner was cooking.
ex.zh: 晚饭还在做的时候，我们在厨房里跳起了舞。

ex.en: Traditional dance can strengthen community identity while offering younger generations a connection to their cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 传统舞蹈能够增强社区认同感，同时让年轻一代与自身文化遗产建立联系。

col: dance to music｜随着音乐跳舞
tip: 随音乐跳舞用dance to music，介词用to。

ex.en: We swim in the indoor pool every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在室内泳池游泳。

ex.en: Schools should teach children to swim because this essential skill improves both physical fitness and water safety.
ex.zh: 学校应教孩子游泳，因为这项基本技能既能增强体能，又能提高水上安全性。

tip: 不规则变化：swim—swam—swum。

ex.en: We play basketball at the park after school.
ex.zh: 放学后，我们在公园打篮球。

ex.en: Team sports such as basketball help young people develop cooperation skills while improving their physical fitness.
ex.zh: 篮球等团队运动有助于年轻人培养协作能力，同时增强体质。

tip: play basketball不加冠词；指一个球用a basketball。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 basketball。

ex.en: We play football in the park every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。

ex.en: Local football clubs can strengthen community relationships by bringing together people from different social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 地方足球俱乐部能够聚集不同社会背景的人，从而增进社区联系。

tip: 英式football指足球；美式通常指美式橄榄球。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 football。

ex.en: We placed a vase in the centre of the table.
ex.zh: 我们在桌子中央摆了一个花瓶。

ex.en: A new community centre could provide affordable exercise facilities and meeting spaces for local residents.
ex.zh: 新的社区中心可以为当地居民提供价格实惠的健身设施和聚会场所。

tip: centre是英式拼写，美式写center；动词常接on。

ex.en: Our kitchen smells wonderful when Dad bakes fresh bread.
ex.zh: 爸爸烤新鲜面包时，我们的厨房里香气四溢。

ex.en: Investing in public transport could improve our quality of life and reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以提高我们的生活质量，并减少城市空气污染。

col: our daily lives｜我们的日常生活
our local community｜我们所在的社区
our shared future｜我们共同的未来
tip: our后须接名词；ours可独立使用。

ex.en: We talked about our weekend plans over breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们吃早饭时聊了聊周末的计划。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to talk openly about stress and seek support when they need it.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生坦诚谈论压力，并在需要时寻求帮助。

tip: talk about接话题；talk to或with接人。

ex.en: Growing herbs on my balcony has become my favourite hobby.
ex.zh: 在阳台种香草已成了我最喜欢的业余爱好。

ex.en: Having a creative hobby can help people manage stress and maintain a healthy balance between work and leisure.
ex.zh: 拥有创造性的业余爱好能帮助人们调节压力，保持工作与休闲之间的健康平衡。

col: take up a hobby｜开始培养一种爱好
a creative hobby｜创造性的业余爱好
pursue a hobby｜从事业余爱好
tip: 可数名词，复数为hobbies；开始一种爱好用take up。

ex.en: The café offers free biscuits with every hot drink.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆每卖一杯热饮都会赠送饼干。

ex.en: Providing free public transport could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment for disadvantaged residents.
ex.zh: 提供免费公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善弱势居民的就业可及性。

tip: be free to do表示可以自由做；for free表示免费。

ex.en: This little bakery sells my favourite kind of bread.
ex.zh: 这家小面包店卖我最喜欢的那种面包。

ex.en: Public libraries allow readers to discover new authors as well as revisit their favourite books without additional cost.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆让读者无需额外花费，既能发现新作家，也能重读自己最喜爱的书。

col: a firm favourite｜一直备受喜爱的人或物
the favourite to win｜夺冠热门
tip: 英式拼写favourite，美式favorite；一般不用most修饰。

ex.en: Swimming is the only sport my sister really enjoys.
ex.zh: 游泳是我姐姐唯一真正喜欢的运动。

ex.en: Regular participation in sport can improve physical health and help young people develop teamwork skills.
ex.zh: 经常参加体育运动能改善身体健康，并帮助年轻人培养团队合作能力。

col: take part in sport｜参加体育运动
tip: 泛指体育时英式常用sport，美式常用sports。

ex.en: We play basketball at the park after school.
ex.zh: 放学后，我们在公园打篮球。

ex.en: Team sports such as basketball help young people develop cooperation skills while improving their physical fitness.
ex.zh: 篮球等团队运动有助于年轻人培养协作能力，同时增强体质。

tip: play basketball不加冠词；指一个球用a basketball。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 basketball。

ex.en: We played a board game after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后我们玩了一个桌游。

ex.en: Cooperative games can help children develop communication skills and learn to solve problems together.
ex.zh: 合作型游戏能帮助儿童培养沟通能力，并学会共同解决问题。

tip: 猎物义不可数；be game for表示愿意尝试。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 game。

ex.en: We took a photo beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们在那座老桥旁拍了张照片。

ex.en: Historical photos provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
ex.zh: 历史照片为研究城市景观和日常生活方式如何随时间变化提供了宝贵证据。

tip: photo是photograph的常用简称；复数为photos。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 photo。

ex.en: We found two empty seats in the front row.
ex.zh: 我们在前排找到了两个空座位。

ex.en: Planting a row of trees beside busy roads can help reduce noise and improve local air quality.
ex.zh: 在繁忙道路旁种植一排树木，有助于降低噪声并改善当地空气质量。

col: in a row｜排成一排；连续
tip: “排、划船”读/rəʊ/；“争吵”英美均读/raʊ/。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 row。

ex.en: Snow covered the mountain even in the middle of summer.
ex.zh: 即使在盛夏，那座山仍被白雪覆盖。

ex.en: Mountain communities often face higher transport costs because steep terrain makes road construction more difficult.
ex.zh: 山区社区往往面临更高的运输成本，因为陡峭的地形增加了修路的难度。

col: a mountain of work｜堆积如山的工作
tip: 一座山用 mountain；山脉通常用 mountain range。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 mountain。

ex.en: Grandma told us a funny story about her childhood.
ex.zh: 奶奶给我们讲了一个她童年的趣事。

ex.en: Sharing a personal story can help students understand historical events from a more human perspective.
ex.zh: 分享个人经历可以帮助学生从更有人情味的角度理解历史事件。

tip: 楼层英式写storey，美式写story；高度不固定。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 story。

ex.en: We had a great afternoon swimming in the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖里游泳，度过了一个愉快的下午。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet is of great importance for students living in remote areas.
ex.zh: 对于居住在偏远地区的学生来说，能够使用可靠的互联网至关重要。

tip: a great deal of后接不可数名词，表示大量。

ex.en: The children built a castle from wet sand.
ex.zh: 孩子们用湿沙堆了一座城堡。

ex.en: Removing sand from riverbeds for construction can damage habitats and increase the risk of erosion.
ex.zh: 为建筑工程开采河床中的沙子可能破坏栖息地，并增加侵蚀风险。

tip: 表示沙子时不可数；一粒沙用a grain of sand。

ex.en: Would you like to join us for lunch today?
ex.zh: 你今天愿意和我们一起吃午饭吗？

ex.en: Students who join local volunteer groups can develop practical skills while contributing to their communities.
ex.zh: 加入当地志愿者团体的学生可以在服务社区的同时培养实用技能。

tip: join a club指加入组织；join in指参与活动。

ex.en: Let's meet outside the library after lunch today.
ex.zh: 我们今天午饭后在图书馆外见吧。

ex.en: Public transport services must meet the needs of residents who cannot afford private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通服务必须满足那些买不起私家车的居民的需求。

col: meet someone for the first time｜初次见到某人
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为met；meet要求时意为满足。

ex.en: I called her after lunch to arrange a walk.
ex.zh: 午饭后我给她打了电话，约好一起散步。

ex.en: When a student requests additional support, teachers should help her access appropriate learning resources.
ex.zh: 当一名女学生请求额外支持时，教师应帮助她获取合适的学习资源。

tip: her可作宾语或接名词表所属；hers独立使用。

ex.en: We played volleyball on the beach until the sun set.
ex.zh: 我们在沙滩上打排球，一直打到日落。

ex.en: Team sports such as volleyball can help students develop communication skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 排球等团队运动既能帮助学生培养沟通能力，也能鼓励他们定期锻炼。

tip: 指运动时不可数，play volleyball中不加冠词。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 volleyball。

ex.en: I pulled on a warm sweater before going outside.
ex.zh: 出门前，我套上了一件暖和的毛衣。

ex.en: Choosing a durable wool sweater rather than several cheap alternatives can reduce clothing waste over time.
ex.zh: 选择一件耐穿的羊毛衫，而不是多件廉价替代品，长远来看可以减少衣物浪费。

tip: 英式英语也常用jumper；sweatshirt指运动衫。

ex.en: I packed a clean T-shirt for the picnic.
ex.zh: 我为野餐带了一件干净的T恤衫。

ex.en: Choosing a durable cotton T-shirt instead of disposable fashion can reduce waste and encourage more responsible consumption.
ex.zh: 选择耐穿的棉质T恤衫而非一次性时尚服饰，可以减少浪费并促进更负责任的消费。

tip: 可数名词，复数为 T-shirts，保留连字符。

ex.en: Her blue skirt swayed as she walked upstairs.
ex.zh: 她上楼时，蓝色裙子轻轻摆动。

ex.en: Public discussions often skirt the issue of who should pay for environmental protection.
ex.zh: 公共讨论往往回避谁应承担环保费用这一问题。

col: skirt the edge of｜沿……边缘行进
tip: skirt是裙子；dress通常指连衣裙。

ex.en: She wore a blue dress to her sister's party.
ex.zh: 她穿了一条蓝色连衣裙去参加姐姐的聚会。

ex.en: Some employers require formal dress, while others allow staff to wear casual clothing at work.
ex.zh: 有些雇主要求穿正装，而另一些则允许员工上班时穿便装。

tip: a dress指连衣裙；get dressed指穿好衣服。

ex.en: He ironed his blue shirt before the interview.
ex.zh: 他在面试前熨好了自己的蓝衬衫。

ex.en: Some employers require staff to wear a formal shirt, while others allow more casual clothing.
ex.zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式衬衫，另一些则允许更休闲的着装。

col: button up a shirt｜扣好衬衫扣子
tip: shirt通常指衬衫；T-shirt才是T恤。

ex.en: These trousers are too long, so I need them shortened.
ex.zh: 这条裤子太长了，我需要把它改短。

ex.en: Some employers require staff to wear formal trousers, while others allow more casual clothing in the workplace.
ex.zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式长裤，另一些则允许员工在工作场所穿得更休闲。

col: a pair of trousers｜一条长裤
tip: 用复数：trousers are；一条用a pair of trousers。

ex.en: I packed shorts and sandals for our beach holiday.
ex.zh: 我为这次海滨度假打包了短裤和凉鞋。

ex.en: In hot weather, lightweight shorts can help people stay comfortable while taking part in outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 天气炎热时，轻薄的短裤能帮助人们在户外锻炼时保持舒适。

col: a pair of shorts｜一条短裤
tip: shorts用复数；一条短裤说a pair of shorts。

ex.en: Hang your wet coat by the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 把你的湿外套挂在厨房门边。

ex.en: Applying a protective coat to metal structures can reduce maintenance costs and extend their useful life.
ex.zh: 给金属结构涂上保护层可以降低维护成本，延长其使用寿命。

col: a coat of paint｜一层油漆
tip: 动词常用coat A with B，意为给A涂上B。

ex.en: He pulled on his cap before leaving for practice.
ex.zh: 他戴上帽子后出门去训练。

ex.en: Governments could cap annual rent increases to protect households from sudden rises in housing costs.
ex.zh: 政府可以限制年度租金涨幅，以保护家庭免受住房成本骤增的影响。

col: a cap on fees｜费用上限
tip: cap作动词指设上限；a cap on后接受限项目。

ex.en: There was a small stone inside my shoe.
ex.zh: 我的鞋里有一颗小石子。

ex.en: Comfortable shoes are essential for workers who spend most of their working day standing.
ex.zh: 对于工作时大部分时间都站着的员工来说，舒适的鞋子至关重要。

tip: 一双鞋用a pair of shoes，shoe为可数名词。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 shoe。

ex.en: I always wear thick socks when the floor feels cold.
ex.zh: 地板凉的时候，我总会穿上厚袜子。

ex.en: Encouraging employees to wear protective equipment can significantly reduce the risk of injuries in industrial workplaces.
ex.zh: 鼓励员工穿戴防护装备，可以显著降低工业场所的工伤风险。

tip: wear强调穿戴状态，put on强调动作；过去式wore。

ex.en: We walk to school together along the river.
ex.zh: 我们一起沿着河边步行上学。

ex.en: Every school should provide opportunities for students to develop practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
ex.zh: 每所学校都应提供机会，让学生在学习学科知识的同时培养实践技能。

tip: go to school指上学；go to the school指去校址。

ex.en: These gloves look similar, but their sizes are different.
ex.zh: 这些手套看起来相似，但尺码不同。

ex.en: Students from different cultural backgrounds can contribute valuable perspectives to classroom discussions about global issues.
ex.zh: 来自不同文化背景的学生能为课堂上的全球议题讨论提供宝贵的视角。

tip: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。

ex.en: Your clean clothes are drying outside in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 你洗干净的衣服正在外面晒太阳。

ex.en: Buying durable clothes rather than frequently replacing cheap garments can reduce household waste and save resources.
ex.zh: 购买耐穿的衣服，而不是频繁更换廉价服装，可以减少家庭垃圾并节约资源。

tip: 只有复数形式；一件衣服用an item of clothing。

ex.en: My school uniform is still drying by the window.
ex.zh: 我的校服还在窗边晾着。

ex.en: Uniform safety standards across all factories can help protect workers and improve overall working conditions.
ex.zh: 所有工厂实行统一的安全标准，有助于保护工人并改善整体工作条件。

tip: 开头是辅音/j/，所以说a uniform，不用an。

ex.en: Whose umbrella is dripping water all over the floor?
ex.zh: 谁的雨伞把水滴得满地都是？

ex.en: Children whose parents read regularly at home may develop a stronger interest in books.
ex.zh: 父母经常在家阅读的孩子可能会对书籍产生更浓厚的兴趣。

tip: whose表示所属；who’s是who is或who has的缩写。

ex.en: We sat around the fire and watched the stars.
ex.zh: 我们围坐在火堆旁看星星。

ex.en: Planting trees around school buildings can provide shade and reduce indoor temperatures during hot weather.
ex.zh: 在教学楼周围种树可以提供遮阴，并在炎热天气下降低室内温度。

col: around the corner｜在拐角处；即将到来
tip: around可表大约；around ten即十点或十个左右。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 around。

ex.en: Look at the tiny bird beside the window.
ex.zh: 看窗边那只小鸟。

ex.en: Public parks often look more attractive when local residents help maintain their gardens and pathways.
ex.zh: 当当地居民协助维护花园和步道时，公共公园往往显得更有吸引力。

tip: look at后接看的对象；look作系动词后接形容词。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 look。

ex.en: I joined a cooking course at the community centre.
ex.zh: 我报名参加了社区中心的烹饪课程。

ex.en: Universities should design each course to combine theoretical knowledge with practical skills relevant to future employment.
ex.zh: 大学应在设计每门课程时，将理论知识与未来就业所需的实用技能相结合。

tip: course 是整门课程；lesson 是其中的一节课。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 course。

ex.en: I left my favourite pair of gloves on the bus.
ex.zh: 我把最喜欢的那双手套落在公交车上了。

ex.en: Teachers often pair students with different strengths to encourage cooperation and improve learning outcomes.
ex.zh: 教师常将各有所长的学生配成一组，以鼓励合作并改善学习成效。

col: a pair of scissors｜一把剪刀
work in pairs｜两人一组工作
pair up with someone｜与某人结成一组
tip: a pair of shoes作主语时，谓语用单数。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 pair。

ex.en: We spread a blanket on the grass beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边的草地上铺了一条毯子。

ex.en: Replacing natural grass with artificial surfaces can reduce habitats for insects and increase local temperatures.
ex.zh: 用人造地面取代天然草地可能减少昆虫的栖息地，并使当地气温升高。

col: a blade of grass｜一片草叶
tip: 通常不可数；一片草叶用a blade of grass。
